name: N. A. Thayer
role: Northern Pacific assistant superintendent of bridges and buildings
bio: N. A. Thayer was the Northern Pacific's assistant superintendent of bridges and buildings for the division and oversaw railroad work at Medora in 1884 and 1885. In January 1886 he and his bridge crew repaired the bridge after cold weather pulled it out of shape.
